headline: Lost-wallet task is solvable from the documents, but the graded database records the freeze-then-unfreeze history, so closing the lost cards directly (as one document recommends) fails.

issues.summary: The gold freezes all three cards, then unfreezes Light Blue and Green only so they can be closed. The freeze/unfreeze dates stay on the closed card records, so an agent that follows doc_026 and closes the confirmed-lost cards without freezing them ends with the same CLOSED cards but a different debit_cards table.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026: "If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing"
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_026: "CLOSE: Permanent deactivation - cannot be reversed. Use when card is confirmed lost/stolen"
tools.py close_debit_card_4721: "Only ACTIVE or PENDING cards can be closed." (a FROZEN card must be unfrozen first)
freeze_debit_card_3892 writes card["frozen_date"]; unfreeze_debit_card_3893 writes card["unfrozen_date"]; both fields stay on the closed card in the gold DB
gold[4..6] freeze lb/green/lg; gold[13..14] unfreeze lb/green; gold[16..17] close lb/green reason "lost"

Replay: gold minus freeze/unfreeze for lb/green -> debit_cards differs only in frozen_date/unfrozen_date on dbc_mc78a5b9d2_lb and dbc_mc78a5b9d2_green; also missing unfreeze_debit_card_3893 in agent_discoverable_tools
issues.why_it_matters: The customer asks for an immediate freeze, so most agents will freeze. An agent that instead recommends closing confirmed-lost cards (doc_026) gets the substantive outcome right and still scores 0.
issues.suggested_fix: Do not persist frozen_date/unfrozen_date on cards that end CLOSED, or exclude those timestamp fields from the DB comparison.

solution_check: Reconstructed: verify, list accounts, read cards (Light Blue has two lost-replacements dated 03/15/2025 and 07/25/2025, so a third exceeds the ENTRY 2-per-12-months limit; customer declines the $25 fee), read transactions (Light Green has two pending rows, so doc_025 requirement 4 blocks closing it), freeze all three as asked, unfreeze and close Light Blue and Green as lost, order Green replacement EXPEDITED $15 (MID tier) with CLASSIC $0 to the address on file. This matches the gold, and the gold replays cleanly; Light Green stays FROZEN.
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean; the gold actions only gained the accounts read in v1.0.1, and the freeze-path sensitivity was not reported before.
notes: Grading-model check against the snapshot: confirmed call_discoverable_agent_tool parses JSON with parse_int=float; reads are logged only when in the gold allowlist; agent_discoverable_tools rows are keyed by tool name only (generate_agent_discoverable_tool_id), so repeat calls collapse to one row; user tools write to the same DB the agent hash covers. Verified scorer (working-repo _verified_db_match) strips closure_reason, but order_debit_card_5739 copies the closed card's closure_reason into the new card's issue_reason (lost/stolen kept, fraud_suspected->fraud, anything else->first_card), so the close reason still decides debit_cards whenever a replacement is ordered after the close. Ordering the Green replacement before closing the old card succeeds (the frozen card is not ACTIVE) but stamps issue_reason=first_card instead of lost (replayed); doc_029 ("can order immediately after closure") implies close-first, so this is noted, not counted. get_credit_card_accounts_by_user (gold[7]) is a non-discoverable read and does not touch the DB. Tier mapping comes only from doc_005 (Light Blue/Light Green ENTRY, Green MID). doc_005 changed in v1.0.1 only by removing a stray "$" in the ELITE fee line.
